stage0011_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Beastman
「If we've come this far, we're safe.」

stage0011_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Beastman
「Poor thing...
　You must've been through something scary.」

stage0011_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
Beastman
「Honestly, humans in this city are so selfish!
　We came from the $$新世界大陸$$ to work,
　and we're doing our best out here...」

stage0011_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Beastman
「It's always 'no partying at night,'
　or 'line up for the train,'
　or 'don't squat in the park'...」

stage0011_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
Beastman
「We can't take this anymore!
　Right!?」

stage0011_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Beastman
「It's fine!
　Our buddy's getting a Gunmen right now
　to make the humans eat their words!」

stage0011_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
Beastman
「Ha ha ha!
　We'll show humans Beastman pride!」

stage0011_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So many Pony Men showed up!」

stage0011_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「They think $$ぽに男$$'s one of their own!?」

stage0011_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アルト$$
「We need to stop that Gunmen, now!」

stage0011_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Call out $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0011_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong!?
　Are you feeling sick!?」

stage0011_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$n
「Sorry, teacher...
　Right after using $$ブーストアップ$$,
　I can't seem to call out $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0011_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But at this rate, the city's...!」

stage0011_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Huh...huh!?
　$$ボン太くん#robot$$'s fighting the Beastmen!?」

stage0011_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$くらら$$
「What are you talking about, $$葵$$.
　That's a mouse.」

stage0011_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「None of you are right.
　According to 'Monthly: A Man's Mascots,'
　that's $$ボン太くん#robot$$...」

stage0011_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「As the mascot of $$ふもふもランド$$,
　he's a veteran with a devoted niche fanbase.」

stage0011_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So how much combat power does
　this $$ボン太くん#robot$$ guy actually have?」

stage0011_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「What are you talking about, $$朔哉$$?
　Mascot characters don't have combat stats.」

stage0011_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Then what's this in front of us!?」

stage0011_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「This is no time for that!」

stage0011_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アルト$$
「I-I don't really get it, but,
　if that Bonta thing says it'll fight,
　let's leave this to it!」

stage0011_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$クラン$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$アルト$$!
　That's $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　Say 'kun', you forehead dummy!」

stage0011_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I've contacted the Quarter!
　Let's evacuate too!」

stage0011_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Don't tell me, that $$ボン太くん#robot$$ is...）

stage0011_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
Beastman
「Hey, you!
　Never seen your facewhat gang are you with?」

stage0011_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
Beastman
「Whatever, you're a Beastman too.
　Join up with us!」

stage0011_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
Beastman
「You bastard!
　Say that and we can't back down now!」

stage0011_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
Beastman
「Everyone, attack!
　Finish off the traitor!」

stage0011_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it all...!
　They're even bringing out Gunmen!」

stage0011_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Don't hold back, $$竜馬$$.
　Punish them your way.」

stage0011_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Fine by me, but what's that bear over there?」

stage0011_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Look closer.
　That's a mouse.」

stage0011_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Fine, whatever!
　If it's not an enemy, leave it be!」

stage0011_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, you Beastman punks!
　My style's a little rough!」

stage0011_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
Beastman
「Nngh...!
　Fine, we'll go all out too!」

stage0011_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
Beastman
「Everyone, assemble!
　Time to show them we're serious!」

stage0011_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
Beastman
「Hahaha! Tremble, human!
　This is the Beastmen's true power!」

stage0011_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You lot should look at the wider world too.」

stage0011_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Been a while, $$甲児$$.
　Good to see the rest doing well too.」

stage0011_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$さやか$$
「That's $$流竜馬$$ piloting it.
　He's the pilot of the legendary Getter Robo,
　and $$甲児$$'s martial arts teacher too.」

stage0011_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ボス$$
「Scary guy, that one.
　Though as an ally, he's the best you could ask for.」

stage0011_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But I heard Getter Robo needs three pilots...」

stage0011_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$竜馬$$!
　Where are $$隼人$$, $$弁慶$$, and $$號$$!?」

stage0011_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I'm in the middle of a training journey.
　What happens to the others isn't my concern.」

stage0011_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I know, I know!
　Let's finish these guys off quick!」

stage0011_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, Fumo-suke!
　We'll crush these punks!」

stage0011_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$竜馬$$...can you understand $$ボン太くん#robot$$?」

stage0011_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$葵$$
「Not that I'm one to talk, but,
　call it wild instinct?」

stage0011_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Anyway!
　These rowdy Beastmen must be suppressed!
　Signal attack orders to all units!」

stage0011_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Ensign $$ミヒロ$$, where's your readback!?」

stage0011_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「S-sorry!
　I got distracted staring at $$ボン太くん#robot$$!」

stage0011_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$レイアム$$
「...Seems the Quarter's bridge is the same...」

stage0011_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Also, we have a transmission from $$ヴィラル$$,
　a special envoy from the $$新世界大陸$$.」

stage0011_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So he wants us to leave the cleanup to him.
　Then let's make ourselves scarce.」

stage0011_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミーナ#120$$
「$$モニカ$$, did you get photos of $$ボン太くん#robot$$!?」

stage0011_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ラム$$
「Print them out for us later, okay!」

stage0011_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Was this all a night's dream...」

stage0011_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ボン太くん#pilot$$
「Fumo! Fumofumo, fumomo, mofu!
　Fumoffu!」

stage0011_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Not fitting in with peacetime's no excuse
　to go bothering other folks!」

stage0011_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$竜馬$$
「We've both got too much fight in us!
　Don't complain if you get beat!」

stage0011_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh...you're really fired up!
　We could make a good team, you and me!」

stage0011_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$甲児$$
「There are plenty of Beastmen out there
　who've settled into human society!」

stage0011_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$甲児$$
「If you can't ever let go of fighting,
　me and Mazinger will take you on!」

stage0011_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アルト$$
「I don't discriminate between Beastmen and humans!」

stage0011_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アルト$$
「So whoever attacks this city,
　I'll beat them down, no matter who!」

stage0011_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Beastmen answer to human law too now!」

stage0011_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　Smash their Gunmen and arrest them all!」

stage0011_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You punks!
　You're the Beastman thugs everyone's talking about!」

stage0011_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you came here to work, then work hard!
　I'll punish anyone who slacks off!」

stage0011_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Still, that $$ボン太くん#robot$$ costume...
　Modified or not, it's got real combat power.」

stage0011_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Don't tell me, whoever's wearing that is...」

stage0011_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$葵$$
「Come on, Beastman.
　Whatever heat's smoldering inside you,
　I'll take it all on.」

stage0011_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$葵$$
「But you'd better be ready!
　Dancouga Nova doesn't hold back!」

stage0011_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That animal...
　Get fooled by looks and you'll pay for it...）

stage0011_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$キリコ$$
（That thing's basically a small AS now.）

stage0011_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Geez, that gloomy sergeant of ours
　sure pulls off the unimaginable!」

stage0011_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Ah...it flew...
　It bounced, it tumbled...」

stage0011_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I wasn't watching $$ボン太くん#robot$$ at all!」

stage0011_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$n
「Nah...just realized you're a woman too, teacher...」

stage0011_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly! Quit teasing adults
　and focus on the battle!」
